reviews.title: Could be great
reviews.text: This app has a lot of potential but it relies on the petrol station owner updating the price. Because of this, they update the prices usually around midnight when they know they can lower the price because they’re not going to be getting much custom. And then they won’t update it until the following night, again at midnight. So what happens is you see ‘updated 8 hours ago’ whilst on your way to work to grab some petrol only to find the prices have been hiked back up since the last update. A very pointless app unfortunately
